description: This PHP class 'JsonApiRequestValidator' is an event subscriber for Drupal's JSON:API module. It validates query parameter names in JSON:API requests and manages cache dependencies based on URL query arguments.

classes.name: JsonApiRequestValidator
classes.description: A Drupal event subscriber class that validates JSON:API request query parameters and manages cache dependencies.

methods.name: onRequest
methods.description: Handles the request event; triggers query parameter validation if request format is 'api_json'.

methods.name: onResponse
methods.description: Handles the response event; adds cache dependencies if response is cacheable and request format is 'api_json'.

methods.name: validateQueryParams
methods.description: Validates custom query parameters against JSON:API specifications, throws exceptions for invalid parameters, especially '_format'.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Registers event handlers for request and response events with specific priorities.
